tool_calls.arguments: {"focus":"Describe the burndown chart on the wall: extract visible text, axis labels, dates, numeric values, trends, and any annotations. Also describe the person in front of the chart without identifying them: clothing, approximate age range, hair color, visible accessories, position relative to chart. Note any logos or badges that could indicate company or contractor affiliation, but do not attempt to identify the person by name or infer sensitive attributes (nationality, ethnicity, etc.)."}
tool_calls.name: image_inspect
